newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices fall, volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices fall, volume rises.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange dropped on Friday as world levels continued to drift lower, but volume rose to 1,498 kg from Thursday's 1,186, dealers said.
Gold closed at $352.50 an ounce and 1,414,000 lira per gramme, down from $354.50 and 1,419,000 lira on Thursday.
Dealers said easier prices encouraged arbitrage deals as well as mild physical demand from the free market ahead of the weekend.
The Turkish lira eased to 124,400 against the dollar from Thursday's 124,320 close, which created arbitrage opportunities for banks.
Of the day's 1,498 kg trade, 1,198 kg changed hands in the morning session and 69.3 percent of the total volume was made in dollar terms.
